id: title:jose-sequeira:stop lifecycle claims from queueing on the op row

review.posthog_relevance: Adds PostgreSQL transaction-level row locking and lease-live checks to the lifecycle engine, potentially improving consistency and preventing race conditions during checkpoint or lease operations.
review.reason: The observed change P1.F6.H1 introduces PostgreSQL transaction-level row locking and a lease-live check within the lifecycle engine. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement to the implementation of the checkpoint and lease management, addressing potential concurrency and consistency issues. review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of transactional and concurrency safeguards, but the full impact depends on the broader system behavior and the specific failure modes this addresses, which are not fully described. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made; this chunk is unassessed.

observations.behavior: Adds a PostgreSQL transaction-level row lock and a lease-live check to the lifecycle engine, and adds jittered polling and a concurrency test.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether another driver's lease was live when this row was read — a read-time fact for the claim precheck, not part of the checkpoint.
